tasks.gr12-prescribed-works-comparison-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL comparison of prescribed works. Cover drama, novel and poetry comparison, theme development, characterization, setting, conflict and evidence-based interpretation. Ask learners to compare two texts or two characters, identify shared and contrasting themes, link genre-specific techniques to meaning and select evidence that supports comparative claims.
tasks.gr12-unseen-poetry-interpretation-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL unseen poetry interpretation. Cover speaker, tone, imagery, diction, structure, line breaks, sound devices and comparison between seen and unseen poems. Ask learners to infer tone, identify imagery, explain form, interpret figurative language and support unseen-poetry responses with concise evidence from the poem.
tasks.gr12-formal-persuasive-writing-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL formal and persuasive writing. Cover argumentative and discursive essays, speeches, articles, formal letters and reviews, with focus on register, tone, audience and format. Ask learners to choose suitable formats, identify persuasive techniques, strengthen thesis statements, distinguish tone levels and correct format errors in transactional writing.
tasks.gr12-midyear-exam-preparation-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL mid-year exam preparation. Cover Paper 1, Paper 2 and Paper 3 revision, timed writing, literature recall, summary timing, oral continuation and exam strategy. Ask learners to identify suitable revision routines, allocate time across sections, choose effective study methods and respond to common exam-preparation scenarios across all three papers.
tasks.gr12-interview-dialogue-t2: Topic: Interviews and Dialogues. Cover planning an interview, its five phases (introduction, rapport, questions, summary, closure), open and closed questions, active listening, dialogue and the suggested durations. Ask Grade 12 learners to name a phase, say what the interviewer does in it, or choose a good question.
tasks.gr12-discussion-debate-panel-t2: Topic: Discussions, Debates and Panels. Cover informal discussion skills, debate terms (resolution, affirmative, negative, burden of proof, rebuttal), debate procedure, panel and forum discussions, the duties of the chairperson, conventional phrases and suggested durations. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain a term, say who does what, or choose a suitable phrase.
tasks.gr12-p1-sentence-structures-t2: Topic: Paper 1 sentence structures and conventions (Grade 12 English HL, Term 2). Cover active and passive voice in the present progressive, present perfect and future, direct and indirect speech, clauses and sentence types, concord, modals, conditionals, the subjunctive and punctuation. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS. Use original short sentences, never a published text.
tasks.gr12-p1-comprehension-visual-t2: Topic: Paper 1 comprehension and visual texts (Grade 12 English HL, Term 2). Cover the Paper 1 layout (70 marks, 2 hours; sections A comprehension 30, B summary 10, C language 30) and time per mark, literal, inferential and evaluative questions, answering for the marks, and the techniques of advertisements and cartoons (headings, fonts, captions, images, exaggeration). Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS. Use original short sentences, never a published text.
